memoryBuilder.verseText: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me.

sequence.prompt: What happened to Daniel? Put it in order.

items.label: Daniel was trusted by the king
Jealous men made a law against prayer
God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did.

pairs.right: Kept praying to God every day
Tried to trap Daniel with a law
Sent an angel to protect Daniel

application.question: Daniel prayed even when it was scary and against the law. What is something scary that YOU can pray about?
application.followUp: Just like Daniel, when you pray in hard times, God is with you — even in the darkest places. You can always pray.
